scope: Government-hosted municipal election sources, including historical county archives, state notices, town records and state archival inventories.

assessment.Elmo: Confirmed missing 2017 mayor and council contests: five named candidates. The county document filename and November 7 date identify the general election, but its internal heading incorrectly says Primary. Treat this metadata discrepancy explicitly during import. The four council rows include write-ins Bert Reed and Ella Ekker; a tie at 23 means winner status must not be inferred without seat count and any tie resolution. The 2019 county results include an Elmo precinct for a district bond vote, not an Elmo municipal candidate contest. 2023 county results cover Emery and Ferron only; absence does not prove Elmo had no candidates.
assessment.Clawson: Confirmed missing 2019 mayoral two-year, council two-year, and council four-year contests: five named candidates. Gary Price and Jerry Price are explicitly write-ins. Totals include county canvass adjustments: Gary Price 42+2=44; Bill Wagner 23+2=25. The 2025 cancellation minutes confirm cancellation but still provide no named roster.
assessment.Lynndyl: Confirmed missing 2021 mayoral, council two-year, and council four-year contests: seven named candidates. Official municipal results are distinct from county precinct reports. The 2015-uploaded Lynndyl-OR.pdf is actually November 4, 2014 county/state/federal results and must not be imported as a 2015 municipal election. Catalog entries for 2017 cancellation, 2019 cancellation and Amber Lloyd declaration currently return 404; these are leads, not verified source records. The 2025 signed cancellation resolution still names no candidates, and the January 2026 mayoral process is appointment, not a public election.
assessment.Alton: Still unresolved for named municipal candidates in the current archive period. Kane County’s 2025 certified summary and sample ballot have no Alton municipal contest. The county Local Information link labeled Town of Alton resolves to tourism information, not a town election archive. The state Public Notice body index contains contact details but no linked meeting notices in its sitemap view. Utah State Archives identifies public council minutes (series 24273) and ordinances/resolutions (series 24185), including microfilm holdings; finding aids establish that records exist but do not themselves supply named candidates. Absence of online returns cannot establish no election or no candidates.

nextSteps: Completed: imported 17 verified historical candidate participation records, preserving write-in labels and office terms. Winner status is not inferred.
Completed: eight municipal result tables imported with 602 total candidate votes, write-in labels, per-contest government sources and no inferred winners.
For Alton, obtain the town-held declarations, canvasses, cancellation resolutions and campaign disclosures for 2013–2025, and consult the state archival minutes for older history.
Continue checking 2025 named rosters for the other towns; finding historical records does not close their 2025 gaps.
reviewSummary: Imported 17 verified historical candidates and eight official municipal result tables. All 17 result options link to candidate profiles on place pages. Alton remains the only municipality lacking candidate records in the currently imported archive.
